title: Oruvan
desc: A fireman is devastated after losing his family to an unfortunate accident. However, he decides to move on in life and later finds solace in nurturing an orphan as his own offspring.

title: Vaigasi Poranthachu
desc: A fatherless young man falls for the daughter of the head of the village. However, things become complicated when her mother helps the couple in eloping, leading to a massive manhunt.

title: Kakkichattai
desc: Murali, a young man, wishes to join the police force but his efforts fail. In response to this huge setback, he joins the wrong side of the law.

title: Vallakottai
desc: Muthuvel decides to accept the blame for a murder he did not commit to fulfil a promise. However, when he learns that the supposed culprit is an innocent man, he changes his mind.

title: Periyanna
desc: While teaching music to a district collector's daughter, a prisoner falls in love with her. Afraid of getting caught, the lovers elope to a village and befriend the village chief, who helps them out.
